name: ANSC 3262
title: Dairy Cattle Management II
description: Dairy farm analysis focused on: Herd management, nutrition, herd health, reproduction, milking system, forages, youngstock care, labor and family management, environmental concerns, and financial management. Field trips required.
requirement_description: ANSC 3261 or SAAS 261; open to junior or higher Animal Science majors and minors.
